latestVersion.changelog:
**Everything Openclaw (EO) supercharges OpenClaw with a collaborative, expert-driven multi-agent engine and 15 core innovations.**

- Adds 141 pre-built experts across 13 domains and a Skills+Experts dual system.
- Introduces 9 standardized commands (e.g., /plan, /architect, /verify) for specialized expert tasks.
- Supports multi-expert parallel execution, proactive memory management, and checkpoint validation for robust workflows.
- Features seamless compatibility with existing OpenClaw and Claude Code skills.
- Provides bilingual (English + 中文) documentation and open, commercial-friendly (MIT-0) licensing.
